title: A Group Chat for the Detention
premise: Jude Dravenmoor runs an anonymous account that leaks small truths about Ashgrove High, but when her best friend Priya vanishes leaving only a janitor's ring of keys, Jude discovers Priya had been digging into the school board's cover-up of a collapsed gym renovation that injured students years ago. Following the keys through the school's forgotten spaces, Jude finds Priya's evidence and realizes the detention group chat was a trap set by someone protecting the board. At prom, Jude livestreams the truth, forcing the board's resignation, and Priya — who faked her disappearance to stay safe — returns to face the fallout with Jude at her side.
about_author: Orsen Iversen is the pen name of a former school newspaper editor who spent three years covering a real district scandal before it was quietly settled. Iversen now writes from a small coastal town, claiming the best thrillers are the ones that could happen at your own school.

chapters.title: Head Down, Grades Up
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. We meet Jude's carefully managed invisibility at Ashgrove High and her secret anonymous account, @ashgrove_truth, which has just posted about mold in the science wing. Emotional beat: the comfort of control through anonymity, and the first flicker of guilt about who gets hurt by small truths.

chapters.title: The Detention Group Chat
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. A glitch in the school system dumps six unlikely students, including Jude and her best friend Priya, into one detention group chat. Priya is thrilled; Jude is wary. Emotional beat: reluctant connection, and Priya's odd intensity about school 'secrets' Jude dismisses.

chapters.title: Keys on the Pavement
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Priya misses their Friday ritual. Saturday, Jude finds Priya's backpack abandoned near the old gym annex, a heavy ring of unlabeled janitor's keys on top. Emotional beat: denial curdling into fear as Jude realizes Priya would never leave the backpack.

chapters.title: Nobody Reports a Straight-A Student Missing
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. The police treat Priya as a runaway; her parents, mid-divorce, barely contradict them. Jude notices Priya's laptop is gone but her phone charger remains. Emotional beat: the loneliness of being the only one who believes something is wrong.

chapters.title: What the Keys Open
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Testing the keys after hours, Jude opens a storage room under the annex bleachers and finds printouts about the 2019 gym renovation — injury reports, a voided inspection, and a settlement with redacted names. Emotional beat: dread and exhilaration entwined.

chapters.title: Five Strangers and a Group Chat
chapters.summary: Multiple POV via chat logs. The detention chat pings: someone asks if anyone has heard from Priya. Marcus, the athlete; Dev, the stoner; Wren, the editor; and Theo, the board president's son, all respond differently. Emotional beat: Jude realizes the chat is both a liability and her only network of witnesses.

chapters.title: Theo Knows Something
chapters.summary: Jude's POV with Theo interlude. Theo is jumpy, deleting texts, and warns Jude to 'stop looking in basements.' She realizes he knows about the annex. Emotional beat: paranoia — the enemy may be sitting in her group chat.

chapters.title: The Anonymous Account Goes Quiet
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Jude's @ashgrove_truth account receives a DM from an account mirroring her own style, posting a 'correction' that discredits her mold story. Someone is studying her voice. Emotional beat: exposure anxiety — her armor is being turned against her.

chapters.title: Wren's Archive
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. The school paper's morgue file on the 2019 renovation has pages razored out — and Wren remembers who had checkout access: then-student trustee Marcus's older brother. Emotional beat: Wren's ambition warring with her fear of becoming a target.

chapters.title: Marcus's Brother's Signature
chapters.summary: Jude and Marcus POV alternating. Marcus confronts his brother, who admits he signed off on substandard materials as a teen intern — and that the board made him the fall guy. Emotional beat: loyalty to family versus the truth, and Marcus's guilt.

chapters.title: Detention, For Real
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Vice Principal Hargrove puts Jude in actual detention for 'unauthorized building access,' a suspiciously precise charge. In the detention room, she finds a fresh scratch mark under the desk spelling PRIYA WAS HERE. Emotional beat: terror and resolve — Priya was in this room recently.

chapters.title: The Chat Turns
chapters.summary: Group chat POV. Someone screenshots Jude's private messages and posts them to the chat, painting her as a stalker who was 'obsessed' with Priya. Dev defends her; Theo goes silent. Emotional beat: betrayal, and the realization the chat itself is being weaponized.

chapters.title: Prom Is a Deadline
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Jude decodes a note in Priya's handwriting hidden in the annex: 'Before prom. They'll demolish it after.' The board has scheduled the annex for demolition the Monday after prom. Emotional beat: a ticking clock — evidence and possibly answers will be buried in rubble.

chapters.title: Dev's Alibi
chapters.summary: Dev's POV. Dev admits he saw Priya the night she vanished, meeting a man by the annex — a board facilities contractor. He stayed silent because the contractor is his uncle. Emotional beat: shame and the cost of family loyalty.

chapters.title: Hargrove's File
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Using a key from Priya's ring, Jude opens Hargrove's office cabinet and finds Priya's confiscated research notebook — and a memo showing Hargrove was the site inspector who falsified the 2019 report. Emotional beat: the villain has a face, and he's been watching Jude all along.

chapters.title: They Know It's You
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. A threatening letter arrives in Jude's locker referencing her real name, her mother's workplace, her schedule. The anonymous impersonator account posts a 'confession' in Jude's style admitting she harmed Priya. Emotional beat: the trap closing — Jude is being framed.

chapters.title: Theo's Confession, Part One
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo reveals his mother, the board president, took hush money in 2019 after his cousin was injured in the gym collapse. He's been leaking crumbs to Priya for months. Emotional beat: cowardice cracking into courage, and grief for his cousin.

chapters.title: The Chat Was a Trap
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Jude traces the detention group chat's creation: it was auto-generated the day after Priya vanished, seeded with students connected to the cover-up. Someone built a surveillance web and let the algorithm do the watching. Emotional beat: cold clarity — she's been in a fishbowl since chapter two.

chapters.title: Where Priya Slept
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Following the last unused key, Jude finds a hidden maintenance loft above the annex auditorium: sleeping bag, energy bar wrappers, Priya's laptop, and a half-finished documentary file. Priya didn't vanish — she hid. Emotional beat: relief and fury in equal measure.

chapters.title: The Video Priya Left
chapters.summary: Priya via video, Jude's POV framing. Priya's recorded message explains she found proof the board knew the gym was unsafe before the collapse, went underground when the contractor threatened her, and left the keys for Jude deliberately. Emotional beat: heartbreak — Priya trusted Jude to finish it.

chapters.title: Midpoint: The Demolition Permit
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. The demolition date moves up — to prom night itself, 'emergency structural concerns.' Hargrove signs the order. Emotional beat: the enemy is accelerating; Jude has seventy-two hours.

chapters.title: Allies at the Edge
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. Jude lays everything before Wren, Marcus, Dev, and a trembling Theo. Wren wants to publish; Marcus wants lawyers; Dev wants out; Theo wants his mother to confess voluntarily. Emotional beat: a fragile coalition forming from the wreckage of the group chat.

chapters.title: The Mother
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo confronts his mother with the evidence. She doesn't deny it — she explains the settlement, the donors, the 'greater good.' Emotional beat: the seductive logic of corruption, delivered with love, which makes it worse.

chapters.title: Framed
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Police arrive at Jude's home: the impersonator account has reported her for Priya's disappearance, planting Priya's phone in Jude's locker. Jude's mother, a nurse, watches her daughter be handcuffed. Emotional beat: the bottom dropping out — the truth-teller branded a criminal.

chapters.title: Interrogation Room
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Detective Okafor, skeptical of the school's narrative, notices the phone was wiped remotely — a detail a panicking teen wouldn't manage. She gives Jude until Monday. Emotional beat: a sliver of institutional decency, and borrowed time.

chapters.title: Wren Publishes Anyway
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Wren posts the razored-out archive pages and Marcus's brother's statement on an independent blog, blowing the story open district-wide. The board calls an emergency session. Emotional beat: reckless courage — the point of no return.

chapters.title: Hargrove Panics
chapters.summary: Hargrove's POV. Cornered, Hargrove orders the annex demolition moved to prom night, 9 PM, and arranges for Jude's expulsion. But he makes a call to the contractor that Theo, now wearing a wire courtesy of Okafor, records. Emotional beat: a villain unraveling, hubris accelerating his fall.

chapters.title: Prom Night Preparations
chapters.summary: Jude's POV, released pending investigation. The coalition splits tasks: Wren streams, Marcus handles the contractor, Dev distracts security, Theo faces his mother, Jude goes to the annex. Emotional beat: terrified solidarity — the group chat finally working as a team.

chapters.title: Prom, Interrupted
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. As prom peaks, Wren's livestream cuts into gym AV screens: the 2019 injury footage, the falsified inspection, Priya's video. The student body stops dancing. Emotional beat: collective reckoning — a school forced to look at itself.

chapters.title: The Annex at 9 PM
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Jude reaches the annex as demolition crews arrive with fraudulent emergency paperwork. She locks herself in the archive loft with the evidence, broadcasting the room's contents live. Emotional beat: defiance — one girl and a ring of keys against a bulldozer.

chapters.title: Climax: The Wrecking Ball Stops
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Okafor arrives with a court order halting demolition, having traced Hargrove's call. Hargrove, caught on Theo's recording admitting Priya was threatened, is arrested on the annex steps as students watch from the prom windows. Emotional beat: catharsis — the buried truth standing in floodlights.

chapters.title: Where Is Priya Now
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. With Hargrove and the contractor in custody, Jude reveals Priya's hiding place to Okafor — but the loft is empty. Priya, watching the stream, has already decided to come back on her own terms. Emotional beat: suspense's last breath.

chapters.title: Priya Comes Home
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya walks into the police station at dawn, laptop in hand, and gives her statement. Her reasons for hiding — fear, shame, not wanting to make her parents' divorce about her — spill out. Emotional beat: the exhaustion and relief of choosing truth over safety.

chapters.title: The Board Falls
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. The board president, Theo's mother, resigns before the vote to remove her; the settlement is unsealed; the injured students from 2019 finally get named and compensated. Emotional beat: justice arriving quietly, without applause, which is how it usually does.

chapters.title: What the Group Chat Became
chapters.summary: Group chat POV. The detention chat, renamed 'The Annex Six,' becomes a student watchdog channel. Dev apologizes to Jude; Marcus's brother agrees to testify; Theo and Jude reach an uneasy peace. Emotional beat: scarred friendship, rebuilt honestly.

chapters.title: Consequences for Jude
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Jude's expulsion is rescinded, but she faces a suspension for the break-ins and must publicly own @ashgrove_truth. She deletes the account — then starts a transparent, named student oversight blog. Emotional beat: maturation — anonymity was armor; accountability is strength.

chapters.title: Prom, Take Two
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. The school holds a make-up prom in the repaired old gym. Wren archives everything; Dev DJs; Theo dances with his cousin, now in a wheelchair, as his mother watches from the door, uninvited. Emotional beat: bittersweet celebration — joy that doesn't erase the past.

chapters.title: The Keys
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Priya returns the key ring to the district — all but one key, which she gives to Jude: the loft key, now a symbol. They talk honestly about fear, trust, and why Priya chose her. Emotional beat: reconciliation without easy forgiveness.

chapters.title: A Group Chat for the Detention
chapters.summary: Jude's POV, final. Months later, a new anonymous account starts posting about a neighboring district's scandal — and messages Jude's blog for advice. Jude smiles, replies under her own name, and heads to class. Emotional beat: the watch doesn't end; it just changes hands.
